blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson reiterated his disdain for corrupt officials on Thursday, stressing that he will not stop going after them. “Mula law enforcement hanggang Senado, napakababa ng tolerance ko sa mga corrupt. I am always consistent in this regard. Talagang hindi ko sila tatantanan,” Lacson said in a social media post. (From law enforcement to the Senate, I have a very low tolerance for the corrupt. I am always consistent in this regard. I will definitely not stop going after them.)
